tagline: 富士数码相机，2011 年发布
description: 富士于2011年推出的数码相机。配备1:3.5-1:5.3 - 24-360mm 15x Optical Zoom Lens, switchable to macro mode.。快门速度8 to 1/2000 sec, 8fps continuous.。使用AVI or MPEG4。有效像素1920 x 1080 (FHD 30 fps), 1280 x 720 (HD 60 fps), 640 x 480 (30 fps), High Speed Movie (80/160/320 fps)。Normal - 45cm, Macro - 5cm。

specs.镜头: 1:3.5-1:5.3 - 24-360mm 15x Optical Zoom Lens, switchable to macro mode.
specs.曝光测光: Program AE, Aperture Priority AE, Shutter Priority AE, Manual, Auto, Advanced, Scene Position or EXR Mode.
specs.传感器: 1/2" EXRCMOS, 16 effective megapixels (4608 × 3456 pixels), 100 to 3200 ISO (6400 and 12800 boosted)
specs.像素: 1920 x 1080 (FHD 30 fps), 1280 x 720 (HD 60 fps), 640 x 480 (30 fps), High Speed Movie (80/160/320 fps)
specs.闪光灯: built-in pop-up, with modes Auto, Red-eye and Slow Sync, Range of 3.20m.
specs.英文简介: The Fujifilm Finepix F600 EXR is a is a compact digital camera announced on August 11th 2011.
